response.courseDescription: 211 Statics Engineering mechanics concepts; force systems; static equilibrium; centroids, centers of gravity; shear and moment diagrams; friction; moments of inertia. Cooperative: Open to UI degree-seeking students.
response.coursePrerequisites: MATH 172, 182, or concurrent enrollment; 4 credits of PHYSICS 201, or PHYSICS 201 and 211 or concurrent enrollment, or PHYSICS 205 or concurrent enrollment.
